title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Legal Explanations for Regulatory Compliance in Social Media Influencer Marketing

live_model.evidence: "we compare gpt-5-nano and gemini-2.5-flash-lite under three prompting strategies"; Table 2 row "gpt-5-nano no_article 0.94 0.91 0.92" (P/R/F1).

prompt.location: Appendix A (base instruction prompt); Appendix B, Table 4 (worked examples)
prompt.note: Three prompting strategies vary how much of the regulatory text/legislation titles are included alongside the base instruction.

claim.metric: F1, no_article prompting strategy, whole dataset

data.source: 1,143 Instagram posts collected by the authors; social-media platform ToS makes redistribution of the raw posts uncertain (not confirmed released)

notes: gpt-4.1-nano (also on the still-callable list) is tested too but is reported to consistently underperform and is dropped from further analysis in favor of gpt-5-nano and gemini-2.5-flash-lite. A 35-post subset is separately analyzed for ambiguous/error cases (Tables 5-7).
